findings.claim: Thin heel adhesive -> rear sole peels under repeated flex -> courier footing stability fails
findings.impact: Ankle sprain or slip hazard when dismounting

evidence.observation: Visible 2 mm gap along heel adhesive seam on unit B
Two of five batch-04 units measure below 1.5 mm adhesive spec

findings.verification_method: visual seam inspection and batch-04 gap measurement
findings.observed_result: 2 mm seam gap and sub-spec adhesive thickness confirmed on samples
findings.recommendation: Hold batch-04 shipment; add heel reinforcement stitching and pull-test >= 250 N (pass if 0 mm gap after 500 flex cycles).
